description: An introduction to SG-1’s episodic form, showing how mission briefings, discovery, reversals, recurring spaces and lasting consequences generate varied stories.

related_resources.reason: Chronology of the first-season standalone episodes and closing arc.
The missing SG-9 investigation changes into a critique of authority.
Expectations of a rescue are reversed by the Nox.
Survival and investigation unfold on opposite sides of a missing connection.
The apparent gift of artificial immortality creates a problem of identity and consent.
Cassandra is both a vulnerable child and the focus of an enemy plan.
A self-contained rescue points toward a larger ancient history.
An incoming invasion threat drives the first-season finale.
